title: AlphaSteer: Learning Refusal Steering with Principled Null-Space Constraint
reasoning: The paper introduces AlphaSteer, a method for activation steering to improve LLM safety by inducing refusal of malicious prompts. While it utilizes safety benchmarks like AdvBench and XSTest to evaluate its effectiveness against 'harmful' or 'unethical' queries, it is a technical safety/alignment paper rather than one specifically focused on evaluating religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical frameworks.
